definitions.full: H4903. mishkab [ מִשְׁכַּב ] noun [masculine] couch, bed ; — suffix מִשְׁכְּבִי Dan 4:2 ; 4:7 ; 4:10 ; ךְָ֯ 2:28-29 , הֵּ֯ 7:1 .

occurrences.englishText: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head on your bed, are these:
“As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.
It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.
Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told the dream before them; but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.
Thus were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.
In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed. Then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.
